targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time,
  SpanAttributes['client.name'] AS client,
  SpanAttributes['am.api.version'] AS api_version,
  count() AS posts
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = 'alertmanager-proxy'
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$environment'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND SpanAttributes['http.route'] IN ('/api/v1/alerts', '/api/v2/alerts')
  AND SpanAttributes['http.request.method'] = 'POST'
GROUP BY time, client, api_version
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time,
  SpanAttributes['client.name'] AS client,
  sum(toInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['am.alerts.firing'])) AS firing,
  sum(toInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['am.alerts.resolved'])) AS resolved
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = 'alertmanager-proxy'
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$environment'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND SpanAttributes['http.route'] IN ('/api/v1/alerts', '/api/v2/alerts')
  AND SpanAttributes['http.request.method'] = 'POST'
GROUP BY time, client
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  SpanAttributes['client.name'] AS client,
  replaceAll(arrayJoin(JSONExtractArrayRaw(SpanAttributes['am.alerts.names'])), '"', '') AS alertname,
  count() AS posts
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = 'alertmanager-proxy'
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$environment'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND SpanAttributes['http.route'] IN ('/api/v1/alerts', '/api/v2/alerts')
  AND SpanAttributes['http.request.method'] = 'POST'
  AND SpanAttributes['am.alerts.names'] != ''
GROUP BY client, alertname
ORDER BY posts DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT
  SpanAttributes['client.name'] AS client,
  SpanAttributes['am.api.version'] AS api_version,
  max(Timestamp) AS last_seen,
  count() AS posts
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = 'alertmanager-proxy'
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$environment'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND SpanAttributes['http.route'] IN ('/api/v1/alerts', '/api/v2/alerts')
  AND SpanAttributes['http.request.method'] = 'POST'
GROUP BY client, api_version
ORDER BY last_seen DESC

SELECT
  SpanAttributes['client.name'] AS client,
  countIf(toUInt16OrZero(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']) >= 400) AS errors,
  count() AS requests,
  errors / requests AS error_rate
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = 'alertmanager-proxy'
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$environment'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND SpanAttributes['http.route'] IN ('/api/v1/alerts', '/api/v2/alerts')
  AND SpanAttributes['http.request.method'] = 'POST'
GROUP BY client
ORDER BY error_rate DESC

SELECT
  Timestamp,
  SpanAttributes['client.name'] AS client,
  SpanAttributes['am.silence.operation'] AS operation,
  SpanAttributes['am.silence.id'] AS silence_id,
  SpanAttributes['am.silence.matchers'] AS matchers,
  SpanAttributes['am.silence.createdBy'] AS created_by
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = 'alertmanager-proxy'
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$environment'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND SpanAttributes['http.route'] IN ('/api/v1/silences', '/api/v2/silences', '/api/v1/silence/{id}', '/api/v2/silence/{id}')
  AND SpanAttributes['am.silence.operation'] != ''
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  silence_id,
  any(client) AS client,
  any(matchers) AS matchers,
  any(created_by) AS created_by,
  minIf(Timestamp, operation = 'create') AS created_at,
  maxIf(Timestamp, operation = 'delete') AS deleted_at,
  dateDiff('second', created_at, deleted_at) AS observed_lifetime_seconds
FROM (
  SELECT Timestamp,
         SpanAttributes['client.name'] AS client,
         SpanAttributes['am.silence.operation'] AS operation,
         SpanAttributes['am.silence.id'] AS silence_id,
         SpanAttributes['am.silence.matchers'] AS matchers,
         SpanAttributes['am.silence.createdBy'] AS created_by
  FROM otel.otel_traces
  WHERE ServiceName = 'alertmanager-proxy'
    AND SpanKind = 'Server'
    AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$environment'
    AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
    AND SpanAttributes['http.route'] IN ('/api/v1/silences', '/api/v2/silences', '/api/v1/silence/{id}', '/api/v2/silence/{id}')
)
WHERE operation IN ('create', 'delete') AND silence_id != ''
GROUP BY silence_id
ORDER BY created_at DESC

-- Partial-fanout detection over the development/production OTel ClickHouse
-- pipeline. A window of 10m is deliberately much larger than normal
-- Prometheus evaluation/resend intervals; adjust it if estate intervals are
-- longer (the rule's `for` duration must cover at least two client intervals).
--
-- The expected peer count is configured per environment here. Keep this in
-- sync with the value exported as am_proxy_client_instances_expected for the
-- Prometheus rule (see deploy/rules/partial_fanout.yml).
--
-- Known clients come from the alert counter emitted by 040/075. Unknown clients
-- are split by client.address from server spans because their metric label is
-- the single bounded value "unknown". Coverage requires every expected proxy
-- instance to be reporting request telemetry; while a proxy is down the query
-- returns no partial-fanout rows, so the false positive is bounded by the
-- window and suppressed rather than blaming correctly-fanned-out clients.
WITH
    now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AS window_start,
    expected AS (
        SELECT '$environment' AS environment, 3 AS expected
    ),
    coverage AS (
        SELECT
            ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] AS environment,
            uniqExact(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']) AS observed_instances
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
        WHERE MetricName = 'am_proxy_requests_total'
          AND TimeUnix >= window_start
        GROUP BY environment
    ),
    known AS (
        SELECT
            ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] AS environment,
            Attributes['client'] AS client,
            '' AS client_address,
            uniqExact(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']) AS instances_reached
        FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
        WHERE MetricName = 'am_proxy_alerts_received_total'
          AND TimeUnix >= window_start
          AND Attributes['endpoint'] IN ('/api/v1/alerts', '/api/v2/alerts')
          AND Attributes['method'] = 'POST'
          AND Attributes['client'] != 'unknown'
        GROUP BY environment, client
    ),
    unknown AS (
        SELECT
            ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] AS environment,
            'unknown' AS client,
            SpanAttributes['client.address'] AS client_address,
            uniqExact(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']) AS instances_reached
        FROM otel.otel_traces
        WHERE ServiceName = 'alertmanager-proxy'
          AND SpanKind = 'Server'
          AND Timestamp >= window_start
          AND SpanAttributes['http.route'] IN ('/api/v1/alerts', '/api/v2/alerts')
          AND SpanAttributes['http.request.method'] = 'POST'
          AND SpanAttributes['client.name'] = 'unknown'
          AND SpanAttributes['client.address'] != ''
        GROUP BY environment, client_address
    )
SELECT
    partial.environment,
    partial.client,
    partial.client_address,
    partial.instances_reached,
    expected.expected,
    coverage.observed_instances
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM known
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM unknown
) AS partial
INNER JOIN expected USING environment
INNER JOIN coverage USING environment
WHERE partial.instances_reached < expected.expected
  AND coverage.observed_instances = expected.expected
ORDER BY partial.client, partial.client_address

panels.title: Proxy latency: server vs upstream p99

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time,
  ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance,
  SpanKind,
  quantile(0.99)(Duration) / 1e9 AS p99_seconds
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = 'alertmanager-proxy'
  AND SpanKind IN ('Server', 'Client')
  AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$environment'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY time, instance, SpanKind
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time,
  ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance,
  countIf(toUInt16OrZero(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']) >= 400) AS errors,
  count() AS requests,
  errors / requests AS error_rate,
  countIf(arrayCount(x -> x = 'am.translation.lossy', Events.Name) > 0) AS lossy_requests
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = 'alertmanager-proxy'
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$environment'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY time, instance
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance,
  max(Value) AS skipped
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE ServiceName = 'alertmanager-proxy'
  AND MetricName = 'am_proxy_inspection_skipped_total'
  AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$environment'
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY instance
ORDER BY skipped DESC

panels.title: Last seen v1 per client / endpoint / filter

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  SpanAttributes['client.name'] AS client,
  SpanAttributes['http.route'] AS endpoint,
  SpanAttributes['am.v1.filter'] AS filter,
  max(Timestamp) AS last_seen,
  count() AS requests
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = 'alertmanager-proxy'
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] = '$environment'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND SpanAttributes['am.api.version'] = 'v1'
GROUP BY client, endpoint, filter
ORDER BY last_seen DESC
